例句

  1. People who don’t feel guilty about occupying two seats on a crowded train really make me angry.
    在擁擠的火車上佔兩個位子還不覺得愧疚的人，真的讓我很生氣。
  2. I know a girl who plays the violin very well.
    我認識一個小提琴拉得很好的女孩。
  3. The man who helped me was very kind.
    幫我的那個男人很親切。
  4. Students who finish early can go home.
    提早寫完的學生可以回家。
  5. Do you know anyone who speaks Korean?
    你認識會說韓語的人嗎？
  6. The woman who sits next to me at work is from Taiwan.
    上班時坐在我旁邊的女士來自台灣。
  7. People who don't say thank you make me sad.
    不說謝謝的人讓我難過。
  8. I feel guilty about eating so much cake.
    我吃了那麼多蛋糕，覺得很有罪惡感。
  9. She is afraid of making mistakes.
    她害怕犯錯。
  10. I'm worried about missing the last bus.
    我擔心錯過末班公車。
  11. Don't feel guilty about taking a day off.
    請一天假不用覺得愧疚。
  12. Tom felt guilty about telling a lie to his mother.
    Tom 對他媽媽說了謊，覺得很愧疚。
  13. My little sister is afraid of swimming in the sea.
    我妹妹害怕在海裡游泳。
  14. My mother is worried about driving in the snow.
    我媽媽擔心在雪中開車。
  15. His jokes always make me happy.
    他的笑話總是讓我很開心。
  16. The long trip made us tired.
    長途旅行讓我們很累。
  17. The news made everyone sad.
    那個消息讓大家很難過。
  18. Hot weather makes me sleepy.
    炎熱的天氣讓我想睡。
  19. What makes you so angry?
    什麼事讓你這麼生氣？
  20. Your letter made my grandmother very happy.
    你的信讓我奶奶很開心。
  21. People who talk loudly on the phone on the train make me angry.
    在火車上大聲講電話的人讓我很生氣。
  22. Passengers who put their bags on the seats make other people angry.
    把包包放在座位上的乘客讓其他人生氣。
  23. I felt guilty about sleeping in class.
    我上課睡覺，覺得很愧疚。
  24. The boy who broke the window felt guilty about it.
    打破窗戶的那個男孩對這件事覺得很愧疚。
  25. Waiting in line for a long time makes me tired.
    排隊排很久讓我很累。
  26. Students who study every day usually do well on tests.
    每天讀書的學生考試通常考得好。
  27. Are you afraid of speaking in front of people?
    你害怕在別人面前說話嗎？
  28. The crowded train made me really tired this morning.
    今天早上擁擠的火車讓我真的很累。
  29. I don't like people who are always late.
    我不喜歡總是遲到的人。
  30. She felt guilty about not calling her parents for a month.
    她一個月沒打電話給爸媽，覺得很愧疚。
  31. Tom still feels guilty about the accident.
    Tom 對那場意外到現在還覺得很愧疚。
